Hi Alice — Monica here (Solutions Engineer). Thanks for the prep questions — answers below at a high level so the session can focus on specifics and trade-offs. I'll bring our air-gap runbook stub and an offline-transfer checklist.

Pre-read answers (short):
- Signed updates & attestations: we support signed release bundles. For air-gapped sites we provide a signed artifact plus a verification utility (SHA256 + signature) and an audit checklist. Update cadence is controllable by the customer; we recommend a quarterly security patch window for regulated setups.
- HSM/KMS: Redwood integrates with AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault natively. We provide an HSM adapter for PKCS#11-compatible modules (YubiHSM tested). Customer-managed keys are supported; we never hold private keys for customer data encryption.
- Offline transfer of weights: we can provide a signed, encrypted model bundle for initial provisioning. If your policy forbids any external transfer, we also support onsite air-gapped seeding via a validated USB workflow with chain-of-custody documentation.

- Duration: 90 minutes (60 min tech, 30 min procurement/security Q&A)

  4) 75–90m: next steps & procurement info
